name: Sleep
doc: Sleep (the spell): the root and one director an action on its target - the main trails, the bubbles with their trails, the particles, the Zzz sprites, the sound; the status. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag145_sleep.cpp) run on the program's memory (its packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: One director an action on its target: the main trails, the bubbles with their trails, the particles, the Zzz sprites, the sound; the status

params.label: Status tick
params.doc: The status at this tick of an action's director

params.label: Particle
params.doc: The sprite sequence particle (a flipbook of 10 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Zzz
params.doc: The sprite sequence zzz (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)
